prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is near, grab it, check properties, do specific task, else approach it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = MoveRobot    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO SpecificTask
	END
